scripts.release: tauri build --bundles nsis && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d='src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis';fs.mkdirSync('release',{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f=>f.endsWith('-setup.exe'))){fs.copyFileSync(p.join(d,f),p.join('release',f));console.log('installer -> '+p.resolve('release',f))}"
